MutationContext.description: Metadata every mutation must carry so retries and stale edits are safe.

TicketCriterion.description: One story-linked criterion a Ticket claims: an observable outcome and the User Stories it delivers, named like `CORE-S3-US6` or `S3-US6` (DR-TK-04, DR-PS-13).

outcome.description: The observable outcome the criterion states.

stories.description: The User Stories the criterion claims.

description: Request payload for the `ticket.spec.move` command: a draft, unpinned Ticket moves its Spec attachment to another Spec of its own Project (DR-DE-05), one atomic change. An Implementation moves with the replacement criteria the destination Spec's stories claim, sent whole and validated against that Spec; absent criteria keep the claims that stand, which must already name the destination. A pinned or executed Ticket stays where it stands (DR-DE-06).

criteria.description: The replacement story-linked criteria an Implementation claims for the Spec it moves to. Only an Implementation carries story-linked criteria (DR-TK-04); the field stays absent for every other kind.

spec_id.description: The Spec of the same Project the Ticket moves to.

ticket_id.description: The Ticket whose Spec attachment moves.

title: TicketSpecMoveRequest
